scope: Unshielded conductor length from the installed gauges to the four module-head supply/receiver interfaces at the inner surface, including all inter-module connections, series wires, shared buses, radial feeds and two leads per differential input. External power/data trunks beyond those interfaces and receiver/controller power are outside this boundary.
